title: Original actor currently authorized Ticket return acknowledgement without internal command or conversation details
$comment: Reuse the existing closed UNKNOWN/COMMITTED/FAILED union. The whole W read surface must be enabled and currently authenticated Ticket READ valid. Safe ACK remains available when ticketReturnToDispatchEnabled or sensitive draft recovery is false; it does not check 048 readiness or write eligibility. Current Ticket READ precedes original principal scope, actor, Ticket, WORKBENCH_TICKET_RETURN_TO_DISPATCH purpose and command UUID lookup. No action/target/version write eligibility check, no command replay and no original internal or selected Session fields.
